summary: Confirmed and empirically reproduced (scratch tree, never touching real .claude/) the skills allow-list post-filter defect: provides.skills entries are directory names but the post-filter looks up the SKILL.md basename, so artifacts.skills is always empty. Surveyed all filtered categories: only skills and context are directory-shaped; context already has correct bespoke handling. Recommend generalizing that existing branch (verified behavior-preserving for all flat categories) plus a total-wipeout zero-result detector.
decisions_made: Generalize the existing context-branch directory-name matching (anchor string filter_category instead of hardcoded 'context') rather than adding a third parallel branch for skills
Leave docs/templates/systemd unfiltered by design -- pre-existing safe omission, out of scope
scripts/tests and scripts/lint omission from provides.scripts is a separate, narrower product-decision item -- flagged, not folded into this fix
Zero-result detector triggers only on total wipeout (#results>0 and #filtered==0), never on partial reduction, to avoid false positives on normal allow-list exclusions
